title: Adaptive Honest Intervals for Sharp Data-Fusion Sensitivity Endpoints with Near Ties
banked_reason: terminal:laundering — the promised all-(n,m) full-profile local honest oracle, sharp simultaneous adaptation order including logarithmic factors, one profile-independent finite-sample honest attaining family, and matching all-procedure converse remain explicitly open; delivered regime results are sound but strictly weaker.
gap_reasons: The headline field-level object—the full-profile local oracle, sharp simultaneous adaptation factor, and one globally attaining procedure for all n and m—remains explicitly open in oeq:full-profile-frontier.

The testing and adaptive-family handles are specifications rather than analyzed procedures, because no sufficient Bernstein degree, expected-length guarantee, or matching converse is delivered for them.
D0.5 decision: kernel_substituted@oeq:full-profile-frontier — delivered kernel strictly weaker than promised.
proof_attempt_summary: D0 established the all-regime exact-tie oracle, the full heterogeneous oracle and sharp adaptation factor in the low-information regime, fixed-dimensional separated-profile behavior, and a finite-sample capped-cell global upper envelope. The field promise collapsed because the higher-information mixed-profile oracle, a single globally attaining honest family, the matching all-procedure converse, and the necessity or removal of the logarithmic factor remained open. The math referee passed the delivered results, while the decision and independent validity gates classified the promise/delivery mismatch as terminal laundering rather than a false theorem.
tldr: Sharp data-fusion sensitivity endpoints are averages of absolute paired-cell gaps, so exact and near ties create a confidence problem that fixed smoothing does not resolve. The exact-tie and low-information frontiers are proved, and a capped-cell coordinate rectangle now gives a finite-sample globally honest endpoint pair with expected summed length of order \(k\min\{a_m,\sqrt{m\log(6m/\delta_0)/n}\}\). Combined with oracle positivity, it yields the global adaptation upper envelope \(C_0\min\{\max(1,a_m\sqrt n),\sqrt{m\log(6m/\delta_0)}\}\). No matching higher-information lower bound, globally optimal family, or resolution of the logarithmic factor is claimed. Causally, the experiment is a faithful finite paired-cell specialized subclass of the Lanners--Rudin--Volfovsky--Parikh sensitivity model, not the actual Project STAR sampling law or the unrestricted nonparametric model.
gap: Published data-fusion work identifies the max/min endpoints and uses fixed smoothing, while confidence adaptation theory concerns linear or ordered functionals and absolute-functional theory concerns point risk. None evaluates the connected-interval local oracle and simultaneous adaptation cost for the paired binomial endpoint experiment.
fill: The project combines exact paired-binomial composite tests, moment-matched alternatives, a finite Bernstein-certified likelihood hierarchy with an explicit size bound, and nested inversion to give an explicit oracle profile, a sharp oracle ratio, and one implementable honest endpoint family.
